spec:
massive multiplayer bomber — one bomb each — every knockout in a chain counts for whoever started it

Pitch the viewers voted for: Drop one bomb at a time with a 3 s fuse; blasts set off every bomb they reach. Most knockouts in a 3 min round wins and you respawn in 3 s, so the skill is lighting other people's bomb piles first. Chat features add blocks, pickups and bomb types.

Design brief:
Controls: move with dx/dy on a grid; action = drop a bomb (one at a time).
Round: grid arena with breakable blocks, 180 s. Then 5 s results and a new arena.
Score: knockouts; every knockout in a chain reaction counts for the player whose bomb started it.
Players: a bomb explodes after 3 s in a cross, breaking blocks and setting off every bomb it reaches. Knocked-out players respawn after 3 s at a random free spot with 2 s of protection; late joiners the same.
Tension: lighting someone else's bomb pile first steals their knockouts; standing near piles risks being caught.
Spectate: follow the largest bomb cluster, cut to the biggest chain when it explodes.
Chat adds: block types, pickups and bomb types in lists the arena picks from (bigger blast, kick bombs, remote bombs).
Day one: grid, bombs, chain explosions, breakable blocks, respawn, knockout credit, round loop.
